verdict.rationale: Turso documents branch creation via CLI (`turso db create ... --from-db`) and explicitly calls out automating branching for per-pull-request databases, plus API-driven provisioning/teardown of isolated databases, which platform engineers could wire into CI. However, there's no first-party CI/CD integration (e.g., GitHub Action, deploy-platform plugin) or documented teardown API call/webhook example, and no independent/hands-on evidence of a real CI pipeline doing this end-to-end. missing for 10: a documented CI/CD integration or GitHub Action for PR-branch lifecycle, an explicit teardown API example/webhook, and independent verification of the automated per-PR workflow in practice.
